business_summary: HK Electric Investments and HK Electric Investments Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and supply of electricity in Hong Kong Island and Lamma Island. The company operates coal-fired units, gas turbines and standby units, gas-fired combined-cycle units, solar power system, and wind turbine with an installed capacity of 3,083 megawatts. It also operated a transmission and distribution network of 7,143 kilometers, as well as served 599,000 residential, commercial, and industrial customers. In addition, the company involved in the financing business. HK Electric Investments and HK Electric Investments Limited was incorporated in 1889 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: HK Electric Investments와 투자 지주 회사인 HK Electric Investments Limited는 홍콩섬과 라마섬에서 전력의 발전, 송전, 배전, 공급을 담당합니다. 이 회사는 석탄 화력 발전소, 가스터빈 및 대기 발전소, 가스 화력 복합 사이클 유닛, 태양광 발전 시스템, 설치 용량 3,083메가와트의 풍력 터빈을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 7,143km에 달하는 송배전 네트워크를 운영했으며 599,000명의 주거용, 상업용 및 산업용 고객에게 서비스를 제공했습니다. 또한, 금융업을 영위하는 회사입니다. HK Electric Investments와 HK Electric Investments Limited는 1889년에 설립되었으며 홍콩에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
